224-1772-3147-8345.description:
Activate Zimone's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, putting Azorius Chancery from your hand onto the battlefield untapped due to Warp Speed.
When Azorius Chancery enters the battlefield, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Holding priority, activate Azorius Chancery by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Azorius Chancery trigger from step 2, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Zimone.
Repeat.

225-280-2645-3430.easyPrerequisites: Stone-Seeder Hierophant doesn't have summoning sickness.
225-280-2645-3430.description:
Activate Golgari Rot Farm by tapping it, adding {B}{B}{B}{G}{G}{G} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Golgari Rot Farm
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

855-5254-6797.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
855-5254-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the creature with power 4 or greater.
When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Army creature token if you don't control one, then putting four +1/+1 counters on an Army you control.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Phantom Train and causing it to become a creature until end of turn
Repeat.

1409-1545-8160.description:
Activate Kwia by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Kwia enters, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability and Trostani trigger.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Kwia.
Resolve the Trostani trigger, causing you to gain life.
Kwia triggers, creating a Lotus token.
Activate the Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Repeat.

132-1283-3263-4687.easyPrerequisites: Myr Welder does not have summoning sickness.
132-1283-3263-4687.description:
Activate Myr Welder using Chromatic Orrery's ability by tapping it, adding at least {2}{G/U}.
Activate Myr Welder using Gilder Bairn's ability by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, targeting any permanent.
Repeat.
132-1283-3263-4687.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may instead use Chromatic Orrery's second ability to draw infinite cards.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

4247-6972-7237.notablePrerequisites: You've gained at least X life this turn.
4247-6972-7237.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Voracious Wurm.
When Voracious Wurm dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

1981-2292-2415-5870.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2292-2415-5870.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Guide of Souls triggers, causing you to gain life and get {E}
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

372-2417-2781.manaNeeded: {5}{U}{W} plus enough mana to pay commander tax, if applicable
372-2417-2781.description:
Cast Abdel Adrian either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {4}{W} and commander tax, if applicable.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Felidar Guardian until Abedl Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Cast Siren's Ruse by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves and enters the battlefield, causing Felidar Guardian to return to the battlefield from exile, and triggering Abdel Adrian and Felidar Guardian's enter abilities.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Felidar Guardian until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian trigger, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Repeat from step 4.

215-1322-3151.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five Elves.
215-1322-3151.description:
Activate Elvish Archdruid by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Elvish Archdruid from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Elvish Archdruid by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

360-3197-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
360-3197-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Soul Warden triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

849-2292-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
849-2292-7084.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Anax and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Anax trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

1061-4603-6968.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is 4 or greater.
You have the city's blessing or control at least nine permanents.
1061-4603-6968.notablePrerequisites: You are able to gain at least 3 life per turn.
1061-4603-6968.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Maralen triggers, causing you to lose 3 life and search your library for Timestream Navigator and put it into your hand.
Cast Timestream Navigator by paying {1}{U}.
If you don't have the city's blessing, Timestream Navigator gives you the city's blessing.
Activate Timestream Navigator by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping and putting it on the bottom of your library, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Gain at least 3 life.
Repeat each turn.

2034-4871-5795-6967-7147.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wretched Throng, adding {C}{C}.
When Wretched Throng dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Holding priority, activate Barkform Harvester by paying {2}, putting Wretched Throng from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Wretched Throng trigger, putting Wretched Throng from your library into your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Wretched Throng by paying {U} due to Honest Rutstein.
Repeat.

1477-1636-4023-6987.notablePrerequisites: Need to have a total of 5 artifact creatures
1477-1636-4023-6987.description:
Cast Robobrain War Mind by paying {3}{U}.
When Robobrain War Mind enters, it and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Robobrain War Mind trigger, causing you to get {E} for each artifact creature you control.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Activate Extruder by sacrificing Robobrain War Mind.
Activate Dr. Madison Li by tapping it and paying {E}{E}{E}{E}{E}, returning Robobrain War Mind from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1170-1329-1492-1849.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one additional artifact on the battlefield.
1170-1329-1492-1849.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Welding Jar from your graveyard.
Cast Welding Jar by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Welding Jar by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

141-4050-6928.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-4050-6928.description:
Cast Prison Break either from your hand by paying {4}{B} or from your graveyard for its mayhem cost by paying {3}{B}, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Prison Break.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Prison Break, with the copy targeting Naru Meha
Resolve the Prison Break copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
141-4050-6928.notes: The cost can be reduced by {1} if Prison Break is in your graveyard.

4885-6188-6911.notablePrerequisites:
Fear of Missing Out cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent. There are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
4885-6188-6911.description:
Declare Fear of Missing Out as an attacker, triggering its ability, causing you to untap it and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Fear of Missing Out, triggering Impostor Syndrome, creating a token copy of Fear of Missing Out that isn't legendary.
When the Fear of Missing Out token enters, it triggers, causing you to rummage
During your next combat phase, declare Fear of Missing Out and the Fear of Missing Out token as attackers.
The Fear of Missing Out token triggers, causing you to untap the nontoken Fear of Missing Out and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2.

2653-5702-6871.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You control a land that enters untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
2653-5702-6871.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Toph triggers, animating a land you control that enters the battlefield untapped.
During your next turn, cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to an animated land.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a copy of the land it is attached to.
When the land token enters, Springheart Nantuko and Nissa trigger.
Holding priority, activate the land token by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Resolve the Nissa trigger, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a copy of the land it is attached to.
Repeat from step 4.

1339-1808-6625-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing a creature token.
When the creature dies, Eloise's first and second abilities trigger, causing you to create a Clue token and then to surveil 1.
Matoya triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

3693-3708-4613.description:
Activate Wall of Limbs by using Walking Ballista's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain 1 life due to its lifelink.
Wall of Limbs triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1479-2907-5700-5701-6664.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-2907-5700-5701-6664.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Scute Swarm trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Scute Swarm trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield untapped as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Scute Swarm triggers.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Scute Swarm trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Scute Swarm triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

2187-4067-4851-6281.description:
Activate Timeless Lotus by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Possessed Skaab.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Possessed Skaab that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Possessed Skaab token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Possessed Skaab from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping Timeless Lotus.
Repeat.

2511-4871-5626-6415.description:
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing another creature and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Chthonian Nightmare ability, returning Wriggling Grub from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Wriggling Grub.
When Wriggling Grub dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Wriggling Grub trigger, creating two 1/1 Worm creature tokens.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.

509-662-1267-2003.manaNeeded: {1}{U}{R} available the first turn, with {4} each even-numbered extra turn
509-662-1267-2003.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
509-662-1267-2003.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Medomai the Ageless.
Medomai the Ageless triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Liquimetal Coating by tapping it, causing Medomai the Ageless to become an artifact.
Cast Idris by paying {1}{U}{R}.
When Idris enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Medomai the Ageless until Idris leaves the battlefield.
Move to your extra turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Idris's vanishing ability triggers, removing a time counter from it.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Idris.
Idris triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat steps 6 through 9 one additional time.
Activate Contagion Engine by paying {4} and tapping it, putting two time counters on Idris.
Repeat from step 6.

2792-5140-5686.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{B}.
2792-5140-5686.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{B}.
Activate Kenrith's fifth ability by paying {4}{B}, returning Great Whale from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Great Whale enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Great Whale, creating a Blood token.
Repeat.

3688-4826-5702-5954.easyPrerequisites: Springheart Nantuko attached to Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
3688-4826-5702-5954.notablePrerequisites: Overlord of the Hauntwoods does not have summoning sickness.
3688-4826-5702-5954.description:
Declare Overlord of the Hauntwoods as an attacker.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods triggers, creating an untapped Everywhere land token due to Archelos.
When the Everywhere token enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers.
Holding priority, activate Everywhere by tapping it, adding {G}.
Zhur-Taa Ancient triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When the Overlord of the Hauntwoods token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a tapped Everywhere land token.
Repeat from step 3.

997-1636-4170-4871.notablePrerequisites:
Fain does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional artifact.
997-1636-4170-4871.description:
Activate Fain's third ability by tapping it and sacrificing another artifact, creating a 2/1 Inkling creature token.
When the Inkling enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the Inkling.
When the Inkling dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

282-1558-3263-4690.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least four basic lands.
Delina does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
282-1558-3263-4690.description:
Declare Delina as an attacker.
Delina triggers, creating at least one nonlegendary token copy of Phylath with haste.
When the Phylath token enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, creating at least four 0/1 Plant creature tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it, sacrificing the Phylath token and the Plant tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

2290-3708-4613.notablePrerequisites: Wall of Limbs has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
2290-3708-4613.description:
Activate Wall of Limbs using Spike Feeder's second ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to gain 2 life.
Wall of Limbs triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

747-1636-3476-5168.notablePrerequisites:
Bloom Tender and Go-Shintai do not have summoning sickness.
You control another nontoken Shrine.
You control a black and a red permanent.
747-1636-3476-5168.description:
Activate Phantatog's first ability by sacrificing another nontoken Shrine, causing Phantatog to get +1/+1 until end of turn.
Activate Bloom Tender by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Go-Shintai by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} and tapping it, returning any Shrine from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the Shrine enters the battlefield, Go-Shintai triggers, creating a 1/1 Shrine enchantment creature token.
When the Shrine token enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

1379-2493-4050-4819.notablePrerequisites: At least six additional creatures in graveyard and/or on the battlefield.
1379-2493-4050-4819.description:
Cast Triumphant Reckoning by paying {6}{W}{W}{W}, returning all nonland permanents from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, returning Triumphant Reckoning from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar seven times by sacrificing Archaeomancer and six other creatures, adding seven {W}.
Repeat.
